mapper.sql: id, repo_id, plan_name, endpoint_json, stress_json, conn_id, db_url, tables_json, warnings_json, status, task_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_gen_plan (repo_id, plan_name, endpoint_json, stress_json, conn_id, db_url, tables_json, warnings_json, status) VALUES (#{repoId}, #{planName}, #{endpointJson}, #{stressJson}, #{connId}, #{dbUrl}, #{tablesJson}, #{warningsJson}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'pending'))
mapper.update: UPDATE data_gen_plan SET plan_name = #{planName}, endpoint_json = #{endpointJson}, stress_json = #{stressJson}, conn_id = #{connId}, db_url = #{dbUrl}, tables_json = #{tablesJson}, warnings_json = #{warningsJson}, status = #{status}, task_id = #{taskId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM data_gen_plan WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE data_gen_plan SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE data_gen_plan SET task_id = #{taskId}, status = 'executed' WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE data_gen_plan SET warnings_json = #{warningsJson} WHERE id = #{id}
